tool.name: ApparentSusceptibility
tool.summary: Apparent susceptibility (SI) from a magnetic anomaly grid (nT, IGRF removed) that has been reduced to the pole (or approximately, the equator). The ground is modelled as a layer of vertical prisms magnetised by induction, and the layer's response is divided out in the Fourier domain.
tool.usage:
The grid's absolute level is not used: the result is a variation about the background susceptibility.

Requires a projected (metre-based) coordinate system.

param.name: in_raster
param.dialogReference: Magnetic anomaly grid in nT, reduced to the pole (or the equator).
param.pythonReference: Magnetic anomaly grid in nT, reduced to the pole (or the equator).

param.name: out_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.
param.pythonReference: Output raster (GeoTIFF), with the input's extent, cell size and coordinate system.

param.name: field
param.dialogReference: Strength of the geomagnetic field (nT). Leave blank to use the IGRF at the centre of the grid in the survey year.
param.pythonReference: Strength of the geomagnetic field (nT). Leave blank to use the IGRF at the centre of the grid in the survey year.

param.name: year
param.dialogReference: Survey year (decimal), for the IGRF field strength.
param.pythonReference: Survey year (decimal), for the IGRF field strength.

param.name: depth
param.dialogReference: Depth to the top of the layer (m).
param.pythonReference: Depth to the top of the layer (m).

param.name: thickness
param.dialogReference: Thickness of the layer (m); 0 = infinite thickness (the usual choice).
param.pythonReference: Thickness of the layer (m); 0 = infinite thickness (the usual choice).

param.name: background
param.dialogReference: Background susceptibility (SI) that the result varies about.
param.pythonReference: Background susceptibility (SI) that the result varies about.

param.name: high_cut
param.displayname: High-cut Wavelength (m, 0 = 4 x cell size, -1 = none)
param.dialogReference: Short wavelengths are removed below this wavelength (m), so the inverse filter does not amplify noise. 0 = 4 x the cell size, -1 = no cut.
param.pythonReference: Short wavelengths are removed below this wavelength (m), so the inverse filter does not amplify noise. 0 = 4 x the cell size, -1 = no cut.

param.name: buffer_size
param.dialogReference: FFT buffer in pixels added around the grid before the Fourier transform, to reduce edge effects. 0 (the default) chooses it as in QGIS: the shorter side of the grid, up to 5000. A value greater than 0 is used as that upper limit instead.
param.pythonReference: FFT buffer in pixels added around the grid before the Fourier transform, to reduce edge effects. 0 (the default) chooses it as in QGIS: the shorter side of the grid, up to 5000. A value greater than 0 is used as that upper limit instead.
